onboarding.iWantToMoveToAnotherValidator: I want to move to another validator?
onboarding.manualNetwork: This wallet cannot be switched from here. Switch it to {{network}} in the wallet itself.
onboarding.neitherLocationServiceAnsweredSoTheInter: Neither location service answered, so the interface stays closed until one does.
onboarding.networkDescription: Your wallet is on another network (chain ID {{chainId}}). The figures here are read from {{network}} and stay current, but staking, unstaking and claiming are off until the wallet is on {{network}}.
onboarding.participationAnswer: {{rule}} Your SAFE stays staked either way.
onboarding.regionRestricted: SAFE Staking and Rewards are unavailable in {{country}}, where your connection appears to be. The location comes from your IP address.
onboarding.rewardsAnswer: <rewards>Rewards</rewards> are not guaranteed. They depend on the validator’s participation and commission, on the SAFE staked across the network, and on how long yours stays staked. They are not added to your stake: you claim them.
onboarding.rewardsAreLowerThanIExpect: rewards are lower than I expect?
onboarding.rewardsArePaidForEachRewardPeriodThrough: Rewards are paid for each reward period through SEF's distribution contract. They are not added to your stake: you claim them. A claim collects everything not yet claimed. Rewards are not guaranteed.
onboarding.riskAnswer: Staked SAFE is not currently subject to <slashing>slashing</slashing>: poor performance costs rewards, not the SAFE itself. The staking contract cannot be upgraded and was audited, but like any contract it can have defects.
onboarding.safeNetwork: This Safe is on another network. Open the app from a Safe on {{network}}.
onboarding.safenetIsADecentralisedTransactionsecuri: Safenet is a decentralised transaction-security network for Safe accounts. Independent Sentinels check transactions, and Validators attest the results. SAFE staked with the Validators backs the network.
onboarding.sefsValidatorListCouldNotBeLoadedSoYour: SEF's validator list could not be loaded, so your stakes cannot be listed.
onboarding.shownRoundedDownToFourDecimalsTheStakeSe: Shown rounded down to four decimals. The stake sends the whole amount, to the last wei.
onboarding.slashingTakesPartOfAStakeAsAPenalty: Slashing takes part of a stake as a penalty. SAFE staked or delegated is not currently subject to slashing: a validator that performs badly costs rewards, not the SAFE itself.
onboarding.stakingOrDelegatingPutsYourSAFEInTheStak: Staking, or delegating, puts your SAFE in the staking contract behind a validator you choose. The SAFE stays yours and earns a share of the rewards for that validator's participation. You run nothing, and you do not control the validator.
onboarding.switchFailed: The wallet did not switch. Switch it to {{network}} in the wallet itself.
onboarding.theSanctionsOracleOnEthereumCouldNotBeRe: The sanctions oracle on Ethereum could not be read for this wallet, so the interface stays closed until it can.
onboarding.theSanctionsOracleOnEthereumListsThisWal: The sanctions oracle on Ethereum lists this wallet address, so it cannot use SAFE Staking.
onboarding.theSanctionsScreeningServiceDidNotAnswer: The sanctions screening service did not answer, so the interface stays closed until it does.
onboarding.theSanctionsScreeningServiceRefusedThisC: The sanctions screening service refused this connection, so SAFE Staking and Rewards are closed to it.
onboarding.theShareOfTheRewardsOnDelegatedSAFEThat: The share of the rewards on delegated SAFE that the validator keeps. Delegators share the rest. A validator below its self-stake requirement keeps none, and its delegators receive it all.
onboarding.thereIsNoDirectSwitchUndelegateWaitOutTh: There is no direct switch. Undelegate, wait out the unstaking period, claim, then delegate again. Nothing is earned in between.
onboarding.thisInterfaceCannotLiftTheRestriction: This interface cannot lift the restriction.
onboarding.thisIsOftenANetworkProblemOrABrowser: This is often a network problem, or a browser extension that blocks the request. Try again once it is resolved.
onboarding.unstakingDefinition: After you undelegate, your SAFE waits in the staking contract for {{period}}. Meanwhile it earns no rewards and cannot be moved. Then Claim, on the Withdrawals page, sends it to your wallet. Withdrawals are paid oldest first.
onboarding.validatorDefinition: A validator runs Safenet infrastructure and attests results. Your rewards follow its participation: below {{threshold}} in a reward period, it and its delegators earn nothing for that period.
onboarding.walletRefusedRemedy: {{reason}} Disconnect the wallet to keep reading the public figures.
onboarding.walletRetryRemedy: {{reason}} Or disconnect the wallet to keep reading the public figures.
onboarding.withdrawAnswer: Undelegate at any time. The SAFE then waits in the staking contract for <period>{{period}}</period>, earns no rewards and cannot be moved. A second transaction claims it to your wallet.
onboarding.yourWalletAsksYouToConfirmNextNothingIs: Your wallet asks you to confirm next. Nothing is sent before that.
onboarding.yourWithdrawalQueueCouldNotBeReadFromEth: Your withdrawal queue could not be read from Ethereum.
